scientific_integrity.assumptions: Uniform length-n words avoiding adjacent ones; no built-in modular or arithmetic predicates; fixed formulas.
limitations: No claim for arbitrary MSO languages or other random word distributions.
Finite checks supplement but do not prove infinite statements.
proof_dependencies: aperiodic monoid characterization of FO word languages
scientific_integrity.statement: Every FO[<,P] sentence on uniformly random no-11 binary words has a limit; the set of all limits is Q(sqrt(5)) intersect [0,1].

title: Exact quadratic-field first-order probability spectrum for golden-mean words
